title: Redlands mass sighting of silver disc

tellings.quote: 200 people see silver disc 40 to 50 ft in diameter, 200 feet altitude. Um 1968, Redlands, California. Um James McDonald did it.

plain: In 1968, about 200 people in Redlands, California, are said to have seen a silver disc 40 to 50 feet across, hanging about 200 feet up. Marik von Rennenkampff, a guest debating a UFO skeptic named Mick West, brings it up as a strong case and credits the investigation to a researcher named James McDonald. If true, a sighting by that many people at once would be hard to put down to one person's mistake.
